03 / About MAPS

Good projects start with the right people.

in

MAPS was founded by Chris Johnson to give teams experienced project management capacity without the overhead of a permanent hire.

Over six years as a project manager, Chris managed more than $40 million in projects, delivering hundreds of them. He also led a team of approximately 20 project managers completing more than 700 projects and $60 million in annual revenue.
